description: Fetch live, structured JSON from a website through a maviapi endpoint. `api` is the API slug (or domain), `endpoint` the endpoint name or path from get_api, and `params` its parameters, path parameters such as {id} included. List endpoints return 10 results unless you pass `limit`; page with `offset`. Each successful call uses one maviapi credit.

api.description: API slug (e.g. "booking") or the site's domain.

params.description: Endpoint parameters, as listed by get_api.

version.description: Call this version of the API instead of the live one (see get_changelog). Rarely needed.

name: call_api
title: Call a maviapi endpoint
